name_input: SERUM INSTITUTE OF INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs records (https://importkey.com/countries/india/serum-institute-of-india-private-limited): "Total Shipments 6472 Records detected ... Latest Cargo 2026-02-28". Exact row quoted: "2026-02-28 | SERUM INSTITUTE OF INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED | CENTRO DE MEDICAMENTOS DE VACCINE FOR HUMAN MEDICINE :[SINGLE VACCINES FOR TETANUS] TETANUS TOXOID VACCINE ADSORBED 1 DOSE- SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC INBOM4, India | MALABO, EQUATORIAL GUINEA | 30024113 | BOL 1119546". Second row: "2026-02-25 | ... | JORDAN ISLAMIC BANK-AL RODA BRANCH | FREE SAMPLES HEPATITIS B VACCINE (RDNA) (ADULT) 1 DOSE- SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC INBOM4, India | AMMAN, JORDAN | 30024112 | BOL 1009399". Source counter: page claims 6472 total shipments; 5 individual shipment rows actually rendered on the free view (3 export rows, 2 import rows). Destination lanes observed: Equatorial Guinea (Malabo), Jordan (Amman); top ports listed: SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC INBOM4 (203), SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC (113), SAHAR AIR (68).
domestic_evidence: Company website (https://www.seruminstitute.com/about_us.php) states: "Serum Institute of India Pvt. Ltd. is now the world's largest vaccine manufacturer by number of doses produced and sold globally (more than 1.5 billion doses)" and "It is estimated that about 65% of the children in the world receive at least one vaccine manufactured by Serum Institute." Site also has a dedicated "Products Supplied in India" section, i.e. domestic supply is asserted. No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract or annual-report domestic/export split could be retrieved: tofler.in returned 404, thecompanycheck.com and zaubacorp.com returned HTTP 403, Google search returned HTTP 429 and the DuckDuckGo/searx backend was unreachable (connection refused). Domestic revenue figures therefore recorded as null — not invented.
note: HS code discrepancy: declared HS 300215 (immunological products, measured doses) vs. actual shipment HS codes seen in customs records 30024113 / 30024112 (HS 3002.41 — single vaccines for human medicine). Per project rule 3 this is NOT a rejection ground: company retained, HS corrected to actual 300241, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Industry label 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas / chemicals) is wrong — actual activity is vaccine/biological manufacturing (pharma). Export activity is factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records with destination and HS code, not merely claimed. Domestic supply remains 'declared_only': the website asserts supply in India but no GST turnover band, tender or contract record was publicly retrievable within the tool budget. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in retrieved sources).
